name: Doris's Militia
summary: Constable Doris Squire has four posts to hold against the ghasts and four volunteers. Assign the right person to each.

stages.journal: Doris has four posts (bell tower, south bridge, forge, funeral lane) and four volunteers: Howie Butterman, Hilda Brom, Jean Myriel and Siv Harga.
stages.hint: Assign each volunteer to the post that suits them, then see the raid through.

stages.journal: The posts are manned, and Doris has said her piece.
We left it to Doris, and the village noticed.
